description: Extract text from an image or PDF via OCR — pass an image/PDF URL, get the recognized text. Useful for reading screenshots, scanned documents, receipts, signs. Engine 2 is best for most cases.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own OCR.space API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

engine.description: OCR engine to use: 1, 2, or 3 (default 2). Engine 2 is best for most cases.

filetype.description: Force the file type instead of letting OCR.space infer it: 'PDF', 'GIF', 'PNG', 'JPG', 'TIF', 'BMP' or 'WEBP'. Inferred from the URL's extension when omitted. Supply it when the URL has no extension (a signed link, a redirect, an API endpoint) — without it OCR.space refuses with E216 rather than guessing.

image_url.description: URL of an image or PDF to run OCR on.

is_table.description: Set true to improve layout detection for tables/receipts (default false).

name: extract_text
title: Extract Text
